verified_from_repository.api_authentication: No route-level authentication observed in reviewed routes

architecture.primary: Harness -> MCP tool sidecar -> existing AI Router REST API -> consensus research
architecture.inference: Each harness continues to use its own model provider; MCP is not a drop-in inference API

networking.policy: Verify actual path from runtime; keep router bound to loopback and restrict container access

security: No Docker socket or privileged containers
Do not expose unauthenticated router API on LAN
Provider-side budgets or manual spending supervision
Do not silently change existing router
implementation_gate: Inspect repository and running router version
Confirm response schemas and terminal statuses
Connect one harness at a time
Benchmark router tool separately from baseline to avoid unfair comparison
known_limitations: No enforceable dollar budget in sidecar
HTTP error handling and polling need production hardening
